supersedes: research-plan.json experiment ordering; previous plan preserved as history
main_decision: First establish learning efficiency and transferable context binding, then scale data. Keep 124M architecture for this diagnostic. Do not promise that another 50M-100M tokens will yield conversation.

local_findings.prior_optimizer_comparison: All three branches peaked at 6e-5; tested optimizer state/beta2, not peak LR.
local_findings.implementation: Reviewed gpt2.py: pre-norm causal attention, tied embeddings, standard residual scaling, shifted CE. Prior math/device audits narrow but do not eliminate implementation causes.

external_comparators.finding: 124M GPT-2 reproduction recipe: approximately 10B targets, 524288-token effective batch, peak LR6e-4, cosine decay. Our batch is 64x smaller: copying LR directly is unjustified.
external_comparators.transfer: Run controlled LR comparison; verify learning before blaming model capacity.

external_comparators.finding: 2T pretraining tokens; instruct MT-Bench1.98, IFEval about29.9. Demonstrates substantial training at this size but also persistent limitations.
external_comparators.transfer: Model size alone does not ensure competent chat, even after enormous training.

external_comparators.finding: Single-run, self-evaluated 134.5M case study:10B initial plus3B continuation, one L20GPU, curated mixed data and SFT. RLVR reduced GSM8K performance.
external_comparators.transfer: Closer resource-constrained comparison, not an independently reproduced guarantee. Even this receives about52.5x our retained token exposure.

external_comparators.finding: Simple synthetic stories yield coherence in much smaller models.
external_comparators.transfer: Test accessible coherent language as one curriculum component; story competence is not conversation/tool acceptance.

external_comparators.finding: Controlled research links in-context learning to training distributions with dynamic meanings and bursty examples.
external_comparators.transfer: Use varied context-specific entity bindings and counterfactuals; this is a hypothesis for our natural-language failures, not proof of cause.

external_comparators.finding: 135M/360M instruction models use smol-smoltalk SFT followed by UltraFeedback DPO.
external_comparators.transfer: Separate general pretraining and instruction learning. Do not start DPO/RL while basic supervised learning is unproven.

external_comparators.finding: APIGen validates generated tool data by format, actual execution and semantics.
external_comparators.transfer: Use real calculate/convert traces, argument correctness and returned-result grounding; external fine-tuning results do not show 60k examples can replace pretraining.

external_comparators.finding: End-to-end tokenizer/pretraining/finetuning/evaluation harness; headline speedrun targets an8xH100 node and benchmark-defined GPT-2 capability.
external_comparators.transfer: Study pipeline design; do not transplant advertised wall-clock times to a Mac or equate benchmark score with our acceptance.

next_steps_proposed.design: Use an isolated copy of own endpoint. Verify it can overfit128 independently generated, balanced context-binding examples with answer-only loss; evaluate disjoint entities and held-out paraphrase/template families separately. Preserve unmodified base and private acceptance.
next_steps_proposed.interpretation: Cannot memorize: inspect optimizer, loss masks, data and update magnitudes. Memorizes but cannot transfer: training distribution/generalization issue. Transfers but prose fails: language foundation remains weak. This diagnostic is not a product pass.

next_steps_proposed.design: Three sequential branches from same endpoint and preserved optimizer state:6e-5,1.2e-4,2.4e-4; same batch, same approved training rows and equal5M-target budget per arm, fixed brief warmup. Track gradient clipping, update/weight ratios, held-out CE and context metrics. Stop for nonfinite/resource failure.
next_steps_proposed.interpretation: 15M targets total costs about2.6-3hours training at prior throughput, excluding setup/eval. Loss may select an optimization candidate, never prove conversation quality. Short horizon cannot establish final optimum. Values are proposed engineering choices, not proven recommendations from literature.

next_steps_proposed.experiment: Data-mixture screen at selected stable LR
next_steps_proposed.design: Sequential broad-only versus mixed simple prose/context data. Original50M-per-arm design can be used for screening, with frozen new development/audit cases and complete dedup provenance.
next_steps_proposed.interpretation: A win supports further evaluation; no short-run behavioral win is inconclusive about long-run potential. Do not use repeated tiny screens as a substitute for a multi-billion-token training budget.

next_steps_proposed.design: If learning diagnostics are healthy, scope a1B-target initial stage within a possible3B-10B campaign, with prospective evaluation milestones and no automatic extension. Revisit hardware before committing months locally.
next_steps_proposed.interpretation: At1400-1600targets/sec:1B7.2-8.3days,3B21.7-24.8days,10B72.3-82.7days pure training. Estimates exclude downtime/eval and assume unchanged configuration. These are compute scales, not predicted usability thresholds. Any cloud investigation restricted to GCP per user; none provisioned.

next_steps_proposed.design: Once foundation improves, use filtered short conversational data plus balanced actual tool traces, missing-argument clarification, no-call cases, corrections and grounded follow-ups. Evaluate full sessions and wrong execution, then consider preference optimization only if justified.
next_steps_proposed.interpretation: Keep original acceptance criteria. Train/evaluate1024positions before claiming full1024chat history; current512language path does not cover it.

rejected_shortcuts: Immediate1B-parameter model on the same inadequate token budget
Treating repetition penalty as a reasoning fix
Assuming synthetic data is automatically good despite our previous failed synthetic-heavy branch
Claiming source benchmark scores, low loss, memorization or tool JSON syntax demonstrate our goal
limits: No experiment launched, weights changed, cloud rented or dataset downloaded in this research turn. Research does not establish a guaranteed path to usable general conversation on current local compute.
